title: #062. Multi-Item Capacitated Lot Sizing (CLSP)
subtitle: Coordinate production batches and setups for multiple items sharing scarce oven hours across periods.

judge.m0: Output must be an object { setups, production, inventory, totalCost }.
judge.m1: Field "{p0}" must have {p1} rows (one per item).
judge.m4: Item {p0} produced {p2} units in period {p1} without an active setup (setups[{p0}][{p1}] = 0).
judge.m6: Inventory balance mismatch for item {p0} in period {p1}: expected {p2}, got {p3}.
judge.m7: Oven hours used in period {p0} ({p1}) exceed capacity ({p2}).
judge.m8: Reported totalCost ({p0}) does not match recomputed cost ({p1}).
judge.m9: Valid CLSP schedule, but totalCost ({p0}) exceeds minimum ({p1}).
